title: The Old Hunters' Camp
text: A camp of trophies, bones and rusted traps, a lean-to rotting in the rain. Someone hunted the same quarry here, years ago, and kept careful notes. The last pages are spattered. The last line just says: it learns.

options.label: The wisest reads the spattered notes.

outcomes.text: Its habits, its weak side, and the way it always turns left. The last pages are about how it stopped turning left.

options.label: Mend the old traps and carry them along.

outcomes.text: Old iron, still good, and set around your camp each night.
Heads and horns. They will sell. The hunter will not need them.
